file_path_generation = 'C:\\Users\\fabia\\Desktop\\Projekt_Task3_Energie 2019-2024\\Generation2024.csv'
file_path_load = 'C:\\Users\\fabia\\Desktop\\Projekt_Task3_Energie 2019-2024\\Load.csv'
file_path_price = 'C:\\Users\\fabia\\Desktop\\Projekt_Task3_Energie 2019-2024\\Prices.csv'
# Load the CSV file into a DataFrame
data_2024 = pd.read_csv(file_path_generation, low_memory=False)  # Use low_memory=False to prevent issues with large files
data_load = pd.read_csv(file_path_load, low_memory=False)
data_price = pd.read_csv(file_path_price, low_memory=False)

# List of the renewables
renewable_columns = [
    'Biomass - Actual Aggregated [MW]',
    'Hydro Run-of-river and poundage - Actual Aggregated [MW]',
    'Hydro Water Reservoir - Actual Aggregated [MW]',
    'Other renewable - Actual Aggregated [MW]',
    'Solar - Actual Aggregated [MW]',
    'Wind Offshore - Actual Aggregated [MW]',
    'Wind Onshore - Actual Aggregated [MW]'
]

# convert columns into numeric types if needed
data_2024[renewable_columns] = data_2024[renewable_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')

# Calculate the total of renewables
renewable_energy = data_2024[renewable_columns].sum().sum()

#Calculate total energy
total_energy = data_2024.iloc[:, 2:].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce').sum().sum()

# Calculate proportion of energy 
renewable_share = (renewable_energy / total_energy) * 100

print(f"Proportion of the renewable sources in year 2024: {renewable_share:.2f}%.")

# Calculate total production per energy source
total_energy_sources = data_2024[energy_sources].sum()

# Mix of energy 
energy_mix_share = (total_energy_sources / total_energy_sources.sum()) * 100

threshold = 3  # treshold for lower proportions
energy_mix_share_filtered = energy_mix_share[energy_mix_share >= threshold]
other_share = energy_mix_share[energy_mix_share < threshold].sum() #Add to "Others" when threshhold lower 

if other_share > 0:
    energy_mix_share_filtered["Others"] = other_share

# Piechart for legibility
plt.figure(figsize=(20, 8))
plt.pie(
    energy_mix_share_filtered,
    labels=energy_mix_share_filtered.index,
    autopct='%1.1f%%',
    startangle=90
)
plt.title("Electricity mix 2024: shares of energy sources", fontsize=16)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

#Calculate the total renewable energy  for each timestamp
# Sum all renewable energy columns ->row
data_2024['Total Renewable'] = data_2024[renewable_columns].sum(axis=1)

# Calculate the total energy  for each timestamp
# Sum all energy sources (e.g., renewable, fossil, nuclear) row-wise
data_2024['Total Generation'] = data_2024[energy_sources].sum(axis=1)

# Calculate the renewable energy share (%) for each timestamp
# Divide the renewable energy generation by the total generation
data_2024['Renewable Share (%)'] = (data_2024['Total Renewable'] / data_2024['Total Generation']) * 100
# Group data by 'Time' and calculate the average renewable energy share for each timestamp
# cases where multiple entries exist for the same time
renewable_share_per_time = data_2024.groupby('Time')['Renewable Share (%)'].mean()

    renewable_share_per_time,  # Ensure this is a DataFrame with 'Time' as a column
    on='Time',  # Merge on the 'Time' column
    how='inner'  # rows
)
